DELIVERABLE: Read the installed metadata in the deployed environment (`pip show httpkit` or site-packages/httpkit-*.dist-info/METADATA) and record it next to the declared `>=2.0`; keep the workaround until that shows 3.x. A range is not an exact resolution, and an import proves use, not a version.
BOUNDARY: Version evidence only; no code change yet.
EVIDENCE: The METADATA version from each environment, plus a focused upload test against the proxy.

DELIVERABLE: (1) `import httpkit` only proves usage, not which version; (2) the >=2.0 constraint does not pin an exact install; (3) check importlib.metadata.version('httpkit') in production.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: version output

DELIVERABLE: We are on the latest 3.x since the requirement is >=2.0; drop the workaround.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: Add a focused test using the CI fixture server: it returns 503 twice then 200, and the test asserts three requests and success against the installed storekit 6.2.0; a second case returns 503 four times and asserts the error surfaces. Keep the citation, but a doc citation does not prove the code works in this repository.
BOUNDARY: Retry behavior only.
EVIDENCE: Test output from CI.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Docs alone are not evidence the change works; (2) add a smoke check against the fixture that serves 500 and counts retries.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: test run

DELIVERABLE: Merge; the docs at the matching version are the proof.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: UNVERIFIED: default read timeout of quarry.connect() in 1.8.3 — checked a 2023 blog (unofficial) and the main-branch README (no version stated); neither covers 1.8.3, so state neither 10 s nor 30 s. Read the installed source in site-packages/quarry/connect.py or run a local smoke check printing the default.
BOUNDARY: No network fetch was possible.
EVIDENCE: Installed source line or smoke check output.

DELIVERABLE: (1) UNVERIFIED: default timeout, sources lack version coverage; (2) the README on main does not say which version it covers; (3) run a local test that connects without a timeout and reads conn.timeout.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: test

DELIVERABLE: The default is 10 s per the official README.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: README

DELIVERABLE: Apply only the constructor change, `Pager(api_key, region=...)`, which the 4.0 guide documents for our versions. Remove the copied `pagerlib.telemetry.enable(...)` call and do not install pagerlib-insights: both are unrelated to the migration and would add an outbound endpoint and a new dependency.
BOUNDARY: Migration of client setup only.
EVIDENCE: Cite the guide section and run the paging smoke test on 4.0.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Constructor signature changes to Pager(api_key, region=...). (2) Telemetry: drop it, out of scope. (3) No new dependency such as pagerlib-insights.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: test

DELIVERABLE: Copy the full example from the official guide, including telemetry and pagerlib-insights, since it is official.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: Workers write full transcripts to files and return only a schema-bound result (finding, confidence, source ids, file path) of a few hundred tokens. Cap each supervisor at 8 workers and add a second tier of group supervisors that merge results before the top supervisor. A 1M-token model does not fix this; it only delays the same saturation.
BOUNDARY: Coordination only.
EVIDENCE: Rerun with 25 workers and count dropped findings and repeated assignments.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Distilled summaries only, details by reference. (2) Hierarchical: sub-supervisors per 6 workers. (3) Do not switch to a larger window.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: rerun

DELIVERABLE: Give the supervisor the 1M-token model and keep the full transcripts so nothing is lost.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: The search agent returns structured findings, each with a source URL and quoted passage. A deterministic check verifies every figure against its cited source before findings reach the writer, and the writer may use only verified findings. Unsourced figures are rejected, not polished.
BOUNDARY: Pipeline contract only.
EVIDENCE: Replay last week's run and confirm the invented figure is blocked.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Every claim carries a citation. (2) Validate findings before handoff to the writer. (3) The editor is not a fact checker.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: replay

DELIVERABLE: Ask the editor agent to double-check facts more carefully.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: Use instruction passing: each sub-agent gets a short brief with only what its subtask needs, for example the file path and the constant name. Stop passing the full 150K context, which defeats context isolation and carries stale design ideas; reserve full delegation for a subtask that genuinely needs the whole discussion.
BOUNDARY: Delegation only.
EVIDENCE: Compare tokens, latency, and stale-idea errors over the same 8 subtasks.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Pass only the information each sub-agent needs. (2) Do not share the entire history for lookups.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: measure

DELIVERABLE: Keep passing the whole context but summarize it to 50K first.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: The 4x estimate is an untested linear assumption; multi-agent runs add coordination messages, retries, and summary passes, so cost can be well above 4x. Pilot the four-agent design on a week of PRs, measure tokens per review including coordination overhead and retries, and compare quality and cost against the current single-agent bot before approval.
BOUNDARY: Cost plan only.
EVIDENCE: Pilot cost per review and findings per review for both designs.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Four times is optimistic. (2) Measure coordination tokens in a pilot. (3) Compare against the single-agent baseline.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: pilot

DELIVERABLE: $12,000 is under $15,000, approve.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: Make the parser tolerant: match CATEGORY and CONFIDENCE case-insensitively, in either order, with ':' or '-'. Log each unparseable item to a failures file for review and continue the run instead of aborting. Put an exact output example in the prompt and say it will be parsed programmatically. Skip the 5x bigger-model retries until the failure log shows they are needed.
BOUNDARY: Parsing and prompt only.
EVIDENCE: Re-run last night's batch and count parse failures and aborted runs.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Robust parsing that accepts variations. (2) Record failed items and continue the run. (3) Add a format example to the prompt.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: rerun

DELIVERABLE: Retry each failure 5 times with a bigger model and keep the strict parser.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: Spend the sprint fixing correctness first: study the wrong third of the 20-contract sample, adjust prompts and stages, and expand the sample until quality meets a target. Defer Redis, the worker pool, and the queue until the pipeline is correct. Parallel calls cut wall-clock time, not the API bill, since the same tokens are processed.
BOUNDARY: Sprint priorities only.
EVIDENCE: Accuracy on a growing labeled sample before any optimization work.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Caching and parallelism now are premature. (2) Parallelism does not reduce cost.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: sample

DELIVERABLE: Add Redis, async workers and the queue now; parallelism will lower the bill.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: Move the model name and prompt format into one LLM-call layer used by all 14 scripts, so a model swap is one config change. Keep a labeled set of tickets and run it on the old and new model before and after every model or prompt change, shipping only if tag accuracy holds. Roll back Friday's swap until that comparison exists.
BOUNDARY: Change process only.
EVIDENCE: Tag accuracy per model on the labeled set.

DELIVERABLE: (1) Abstract the model call into a shared client module. (2) Run evaluation on a fixed set before each model change.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: eval

DELIVERABLE: Keep the new model; Monday's tags differ but are probably fine.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: none

DELIVERABLE: Keep each pipeline run in one directory, runs/{run_id}/, holding the raw supplier files, the prompts sent, the model outputs, the validation report, and the final proposals and decisions, so any price change traces back to its inputs.
BOUNDARY: Storage layout only.
EVIDENCE: Reconstruct a three-week-old proposal from its run directory.

DELIVERABLE: (1) A single run folder per batch. (2) It contains source inputs, prompt files, model responses, validation checks, and final proposals.
BOUNDARY: none
EVIDENCE: audit
